description: Semantic WPF UI Navigation View block.

paneDisplayMode.description: Navigation pane placement for this persistent desktop shell. Left uses the standard item template. LeftMinimal with isPaneOpen=false uses the current upstream template's fixed 40 DIP icon rail; use open Left or LeftFluent when labels or a wider navigation proportion matter. LeftFluent uses large icons with titles underneath. Top and Bottom place navigation on the matching horizontal edge.

isPaneOpen.description: Whether the left navigation pane is expanded. Set false with LeftMinimal for a narrow icon rail; provide icon slots so collapsed entries remain recognizable.

openPaneLength.description: Width in device-independent pixels of the expanded left pane. Use the measured viewport proportion instead of accepting an unsuitable default.

content.description: Primary page content displayed in the navigation content surface.

footer.description: Persistent navigation actions rendered at the bottom of the pane.

items.description: Ordered primary navigation entries and separators.
